title: Settings
description: Manage your profile, how {brand} looks and your account security.

profile.title: Your account
profile.description: Your school manages these details. To change your name or email, contact your school's administration.

avatar.title: Avatar
avatar.description: Choose the picture shown next to your name across {brand}.
avatar.label: Avatars

appearance.title: Theme
appearance.description: Choose how {brand} looks on this device.
appearance.label: Theme

options.light: Bright and clear, for daytime and well-lit rooms.
options.dark: Easy on the eyes in the evening and in dim light.
options.system: Follows your device's light or dark setting automatically.

language.title: Interface language
language.description: Menus, buttons and messages appear in this language. It's saved to your account, so it follows you to every device.
language.label: Languages

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.inAppDescription: New homework, tests, announcements and replies appear under the bell at the top of the page.

learning.title: Learning preferences
learning.description: Your AI tutor uses these to explain things in the way that suits you best.

easy.title: Simple
easy.description: Short steps and lots of examples.

medium.title: Balanced
medium.description: Clear explanations at your grade level.

friend.title: Cheerful friend
friend.description: Friendly, with jokes and everyday examples.

strict.title: Strict teacher
strict.description: Formal and precise, focused on rules and concepts.

coach.title: Motivating coach
coach.description: Energetic and encouraging, always cheering you on.

scientist.title: Curious scientist
scientist.description: Loves exploring, asks open questions and links ideas to science.

hobbies.label: Hobbies and interests
hobbies.description: Your tutor uses them in examples. Add up to {max}.
hobbies.limit: You can add up to {max} hobbies.
hobbies.duplicate: That hobby is already on your list.

password.title: Password
password.description: Use a strong password that you don't use on any other site.

twoFactor.title: Two-step verification
twoFactor.description: A code from your authenticator app at every sign-in.
twoFactor.requiredNote: Your role requires it, so it can't be turned off.
twoFactor.onNote: Your account asks for a code from your phone at every sign-in.
twoFactor.offNote: Add a second layer of protection: even with your password, nobody can sign in without your phone.
twoFactor.pendingNote: You started the setup but never confirmed a code. Finish it to turn protection on.
twoFactor.disableDescription: Your account will be protected by your password only. Enter your password to confirm.

backupCodes.title: Backup codes
backupCodes.description: One-time codes for signing in when your phone isn't with you.
backupCodes.regenerateDescription: Your current backup codes will stop working. Enter your password to continue.
backupCodes.readyDescription: Save them now: they won't be shown again.
backupCodes.confirmSaved: I've saved my new backup codes

errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many wrong attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
errors.unknown: That didn't work. Please try again.
errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

sessions.title: Signed-in devices
sessions.description: Devices that can open your account right now.
sessions.revokeDescription: Whoever uses it will have to sign in again.
sessions.revokeOthersDescription: Every device except this one will be signed out and will need your password again.
sessions.revokedOthers: {count, plural, =0 {No other devices were signed in.} one {# device was signed out.} other {# devices were signed out.}}
sessions.onlyThis: Only this device is signed in.
